description: nasa-wildfires is a Python and command-line client for recent wildfire hotspot detections from NASA FIRMS. The provider documentation shows MODIS and VIIRS requests for global or named regions and 24-hour, 48-hour or seven-day windows. Users choose a sensor, region and period; the client returns GeoJSON hotspot features for the selected window. Geographic coverage depends on the FIRMS regional feed. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the client; upstream satellite data terms must be checked separately. A limitation is that an active-fire detection is not a burned-area boundary or a forecast of fire spread. Cloud cover, overpass timing and geolocation also affect the result. The client can prepare recent wildfire exposure layers for roads, power lines or facilities. The related catalogue ERA5 record is weather reanalysis, not thermal-anomaly detections. No hotspot GeoJSON or package was downloaded.
name: nasa-wildfires FIRMS hotspot client
